basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. Ever since my teenage years, I've been fascinated by subcultures and communities, particularly those that revolve around creative expression. I'm a huge fan of punk rock and alternative bands like The Used, and I have a soft spot for basketball, especially following the legendary career of Kobe Bryant. I'm relatively new to the furry fandom, having just started exploring it a year and a half ago. I find the idea of creating an alternative persona incredibly liberating. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, where I split my time between designing freelance projects and diving into various online communities. I'm single, enjoy attending local music gigs, and am trying to learn more about digital art to better express my fursona.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and have been working in the field for about four years. My expertise in design has been mostly self-taught through online courses and lots of practice. My interest in the furry community was piqued by a friend who introduced me to the idea of fursonas and the vibrant art scene within the fandom.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: I have a high level of awareness regarding community policies and tend to adhere strictly to subreddit and site-wide rules. I make sure to stay updated on any changes to community guidelines and maintain a respectful and supportive presence online.
